skill.name: google-maps-api-skill
skill.description: Runs BrowserAct Google Maps API workflows to collect structured local business listings from keyword, language, and country inputs.
skill.summary: Collect local business listings from Google Maps through BrowserAct API workflows.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution and reconnaissance alerts are Markdown formatting or ordinary API error handling false positives. Confirmed issues are the intended outbound BrowserAct API calls, unsafe guidance to collect an API key through the agent, and business-contact harvesting risk.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY in chat. Require an environment variable, secret manager, or platform secret input only.
Document the BrowserAct endpoint, the submitted search parameters, and any data retention expectations before the skill sends requests.
Add guidance to follow Google Maps terms, privacy rules, and outreach laws before creating lead lists or syncing contacts to a CRM.
Fix the polling loop so successful tasks continue to result retrieval instead of always returning after the timeout message.

content.value_statement: Manual local business research is slow and inconsistent. This skill uses BrowserAct Google Maps workflows to collect structured business listing data.
actual_capabilities: Submits Google Maps search tasks to BrowserAct by keyword, language, and country.
Authenticates with a BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable.
Polls BrowserAct task status and prints timestamped progress updates.
Handles invalid authorization responses with a clear error message.
Documents expected fields such as business name, category, address, phone, website, rating, and review count.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and outbound network access.
Sends search parameters and task identifiers to BrowserAct APIs.
Current script control flow may not print final retrieved results.
Does not verify legal permission for scraping, outreach, or CRM imports.

use_cases.title: Build Regional Prospect Lists
use_cases.description: Collect business names, addresses, websites, and phone numbers for a defined category and country.

use_cases.title: Compare Local Competitors
use_cases.description: Review ratings, review counts, and categories for businesses in a selected market.

use_cases.title: Audit Local Search Coverage
use_cases.description: Gather visible listings for service providers to support local SEO and directory checks.

prompt_templates.title: Find Local Businesses
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for one category in one country.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find coffee shops in Austin with language en and country us. Return business names, addresses, websites, and ratings.

prompt_templates.title: Create Outreach Candidates
prompt_templates.scenario: Collect contact fields for a focused prospect list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for dental clinics in Toronto with language en and country ca. Summarize entries with phone numbers and websites when available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Adjacent Categories
prompt_templates.scenario: Research nearby categories for market comparison.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run searches for gyms and pilates studios in Berlin with language en and country de. Compare categories, ratings, and review counts.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Country Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Google Maps listing data for solar installers in us, gb, and au. Separate results by country and flag missing contact details.

output_examples.output: A concise list of coffee shops with names, street addresses, phone numbers, website links, ratings, review counts, and status when available.

output: Clinic names grouped with addresses and contact details.
Ratings and review counts for quick comparison.
Notes for records missing a phone number or website.

output_examples.output: A country-separated summary of hotel listings, categories, ratings, review volume, websites, and visible business status.

best_practices: Confirm the keyword, language, and country before running the workflow.
Store the API key in an environment variable or secret manager.
Review platform terms and outreach rules before using collected contact data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, chat messages, or shared transcripts.
Do not run broad lead scraping without a defined business and compliance purpose.
Do not assume listings are complete, current, or suitable for automated outreach.

faq.question: What data can this skill collect?
faq.answer: It targets Google Maps business listing fields such as name, category, address, phone, website, rating, reviews, and status.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY from a local environment variable or another secure secret source.

faq.question: Does it browse Google Maps directly?
faq.answer: No. The script calls BrowserAct workflow API endpoints that run the Google Maps automation.

faq.question: Can it choose country and language?
faq.answer: Yes. The script accepts keyword, language, and country arguments for each search task.

faq.question: Is the output always complete?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on BrowserAct, Google Maps availability, query quality, and the current script control flow.

faq.question: Can I use it for sales outreach?
faq.answer: Use it only after checking applicable platform terms, privacy requirements, and outreach compliance rules.
